headline: Samsung and SK Hynix unveil $950 billion U.S. chip supply partnerships
summary: Investing.com -- Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix will pursue memory-chip supply partnerships with major U.S. technology companies valued at a combined $950 billion, Reuters reported, citing South Korean presidential adviser Kim Yong-beom.
